ABS vs ASA : quel plastique technique po: ABS vs ASA: which engineering plastic for your project?
ABS et ASA partagent des propriétés méca: ABS and ASA share very similar mechanical properties but differ on one crucial point: UV resistance. This comparison helps you choose between these two engineering materials available in our Welkenraedt workshop.
ABS vs ASA : les chiffres côte à côte: ABS vs ASA: the figures side by side
L'ABS reste excellent pour les pièces te: ABS remains excellent for indoor technical parts. Its big advantage: acetone smoothing gives near-perfect surfaces. Its weak point is a major one: exposed to UV, it yellows quickly and becomes brittle. Reserve it for indoor use only.
L'ASA a été spécifiquement développé pou: ASA was developed specifically for outdoor applications. Its mechanical properties are almost identical to ABS, but its resistance to UV and weathering is incomparably better. The extra cost over ABS is fully justified for any outdoor use.

La pièce reste en intérieur, vous avez b: The part stays indoors, you need acetone smoothing, and budget matters. ABS is the reference for indoor technical parts up to ~100°C.
Dans le doute, choisissez l'ASA. Il fait: When in doubt, choose ASA. It does everything ABS does, and does it better outdoors. The price difference is minimal compared with the long-term durability gained.

Questions fréquentes ABS vs ASA: ABS vs ASA: frequently asked questions
L'ASA peut-il être lissé à l'acétone com: Can ASA be smoothed with acetone like ABS?
L'ASA est partiellement soluble à l'acét: ASA is partially soluble in acetone, but the result is less perfect than with ABS. For a smooth finish on ASA, we prefer progressive sanding followed by a spray primer. For optimal chemical smoothing, ABS remains superior.
Combien de temps l'ASA résiste-t-il aux: How long does ASA resist UV?
L'ASA est formulé pour résister aux UV s: ASA is formulated to withstand UV for 5 to 10 years in normal outdoor conditions, without significant discolouration or embrittlement. That is why it is used in the automotive industry and outdoor electronics.
L'ABS et l'ASA sont-ils dangereux à impr: Are ABS and ASA dangerous to print?
Les deux émettent des composés volatils: Both release volatile compounds during printing, including styrene for ABS. In our workshop, all ABS/ASA prints are made in closed enclosures with filtration. For workshop use, good ventilation is essential.
Peut-on peindre l'ABS et l'ASA?: Can ABS and ASA be painted?
Oui, les deux acceptent très bien la pei: Yes, both take acrylic paint and lacquer very well after a suitable primer. ASA takes automotive body paints particularly well, which makes it a popular choice for vehicle parts.
ABS ou ASA pour une impression 3D de piè: ABS or ASA for 3D-printed drone parts?
Pour les drones utilisés en extérieur, l: For drones used outdoors, ASA is the obvious choice: resistance to UV, weather and temperature changes. If the drone is only used indoors, ABS is suitable and cheaper. In both cases, a high infill (40–60%) is recommended for impact resistance.
ABS et ASA en impression 3D : tout ce qu: ABS and ASA in 3D printing: everything you need to know before ordering
L'ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiène Styrène): ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) is one of the best-known engineering plastics in the world. Used for decades in the automotive industry, consumer electronics and toy manufacturing, it was one of the first materials adopted by FDM 3D printing. Its heat resistance up to 100°C, its rigidity and the possibility of chemical smoothing with acetone make it a popular choice for indoor functional parts.
L'ASA (Acrylonitrile Styrène Acrylate) e: ASA (acrylonitrile styrene acrylate) appeared later as a direct answer to the limitations of ABS against UV and weathering. Originally developed for exterior automotive applications (mirrors, bumper trims, signage housings), ASA offers mechanical and thermal properties almost identical to ABS but with incomparably better UV resistance. It does not yellow, does not become brittle and keeps its mechanical properties after years of sun exposure.
Dans notre atelier de Welkenraedt, nous: In our Welkenraedt workshop, we print ABS and ASA in closed enclosures with controlled chamber temperature. This is essential for these materials, which are very sensitive to temperature variations during printing: a draught is enough to cause delamination or warping (lifting from the build plate). On unsuitable open-source machines these materials are hard to master; in a professional workshop we get repeatable, consistent results.
Pour les entreprises belges qui ont des: For Belgian companies with parts exposed outdoors, such as road signs, agricultural equipment, security system housings or street-lighting brackets, ASA is systematically our recommendation. The marginal extra cost over ABS is largely offset by longer durability and no maintenance due to yellowing or embrittlement.
Un usage moins connu mais très efficace: A lesser-known but very effective use of ASA: motorsport car parts. Several motorsport teams in the region use our service to produce ASA guards, aerodynamic covers and trim parts exposed to UV and to large temperature differences between the inside and outside of the vehicle.

PA12-CF vs PA12-GF : fibre carbone ou fi: PA12-CF vs PA12-GF: carbon fibre or glass fibre?
PA12-CF (Nylon fibre de carbone) et PA12: PA12-CF (carbon-fibre nylon) and PA12-GF (glass-fibre nylon) share the same nylon base, but their reinforcements give them very different behaviours. This detailed comparison helps you make the right choice for your industrial application.
PA12-CF vs PA12-GF : les différences clé: PA12-CF vs PA12-GF: the key differences
La fibre de carbone courte disperse dans: Short carbon fibre gives the nylon matrix exceptional stiffness and lightness. Ideal for structural parts where weight is a key constraint. Critical point: it is brittle under point impacts, so avoid it for any part likely to take direct hits.
La fibre de verre offre un renfort plus: Glass fibre offers a more balanced reinforcement: less stiff than carbon fibre, but much more impact-resistant and less brittle. It is often the best choice for industrial parts subject to dynamic loads or continuous vibration.
Structure portante légère, ratio résista: Lightweight load-bearing structure, critical strength-to-weight ratio, static loading.
Gabarit soumis à des chocs répétés lors: Jig subject to repeated impacts in daily use.
Légèreté maximale, chargement statique,: Maximum lightness, static loading, limited impact risk.
Support, bride, pièce soumise à des vibr: Bracket, flange, part subject to regular vibration and impacts.
Stabilité dimensionnelle critique, faibl: Critical dimensional stability, low thermal expansion required.
Risque de chute ou d'impact, résistance: Risk of drops or impacts, all-round strength required.
Quand la rigidité et le poids minimal so: When stiffness and minimum weight are the priority, with no risk of point impact. Structural applications, aerospace, motorsport and precision jigs.
Quand vous avez besoin de résistance méc: When you need high mechanical strength with impact tolerance. Common industrial applications, production tools, assemblies in dynamic environments.
La distinction CF vs GF n'est pas toujou: The CF vs GF distinction is not always obvious. Describe your application and we will recommend the right composite, free of charge, with your quote.
Questions fréquentes PA12-CF vs PA12-GF: PA12-CF vs PA12-GF: frequently asked questions
Ces matériaux sont-ils compatibles avec: Are these materials compatible with standard FDM printers?
Non. PA12-CF et PA12-GF sont abrasifs et: No. PA12-CF and PA12-GF are abrasive and require hardened steel nozzles and high-temperature extruders. On a consumer printer with a brass nozzle, these materials destroy it within a few hours. Our machines are equipped accordingly.
Peut-on usiner ou percer les pièces aprè: Can the parts be machined or drilled after printing?
Oui, les deux matériaux peuvent être per: Yes, both materials can be drilled, milled and tapped. Use tools suited to composites. For critical threads, we recommend embedding metal inserts during printing.
Quelle est la différence de prix entre P: What is the price difference between PA12-CF and PA12-GF?
La fibre de carbone est généralement 20: Carbon fibre is generally 20 to 40% more expensive than glass fibre as a raw material. On the final quote, the difference also depends on the volume of material. Ask for a comparative quote for your specific part.
Ces matériaux résistent-ils aux huiles e: Do these materials resist oils and solvents?
La base Nylon PA12 offre une bonne résis: The PA12 nylon base offers good resistance to mineral oils, greases and aliphatic solvents. It resists concentrated acids and chlorinated solvents poorly. Tell us which chemicals will be in contact so we can validate before production.
La surface rugueuse des composites est-e: Is the rough surface of composites a problem?
Pour les applications fonctionnelles (pi: For functional applications (mechanical parts, jigs), roughness is generally not a problem. For applications that need a smooth surface, post-processing by sanding followed by a primer is possible, but costly on such hard materials.
Peut-on utiliser PA12-CF ou PA12-GF en S: Can PA12-CF or PA12-GF be used in SLS?
Le PA12-GF est disponible en version SLS: PA12-GF is available in an SLS version in our catalogue (sls-pa12-charge-verre). SLS PA12-GF offers support-free geometries impossible in FDM, with even better mechanical strength. Contact us to compare the two processes for your application.
Composites fibre en impression 3D : pour: Fibre composites in 3D printing: why fibre changes everything
L'ajout de fibres courtes dans une matri: Adding short fibres to a polymer matrix is one of the most significant innovations of recent years in FDM 3D printing. The principle is simple: microscopic carbon or glass fibres are mixed into the PA12 nylon filament before extrusion. During printing, these fibres partly align in the deposition direction, creating a directional reinforcement effect that drastically improves the stiffness and mechanical strength of the finished part.
Le PA12-CF (fibre de carbone courte) est: PA12-CF (short carbon fibre) is the stiffest composite we offer in FDM. Its Young's modulus, the measure of its stiffness, is two to three times higher than that of pure PA12 nylon. It is also lighter than glass fibre, making it the preferred choice for aerospace, motorsport and any equipment where the strength-to-weight ratio is critical. On the other hand, carbon fibres make it more brittle under impact: a PA12-CF part fractures cleanly rather than deforming gradually.
Le PA12-GF (fibre de verre courte) offre: PA12-GF (short glass fibre) offers a more balanced compromise. Its stiffness is lower than carbon, but its impact resistance is clearly better. Glass fibres are less abrasive than carbon fibres, which makes them slightly less aggressive for print nozzles, although both our materials require hardened steel nozzles. For industrial parts subject to continuous vibration, repeated impacts or dynamic loads, PA12-GF is generally our first recommendation.
Un point technique important pour les de: An important technical point for both materials: print orientation has a significant influence on the final mechanical properties. The fibres align in the extrusion direction, which creates anisotropy: the part will be stronger in the XY direction than in the Z direction (between layers). Our technician systematically analyses your part to determine the optimal orientation according to the main stress axes of your application.
Ces deux matériaux sont disponibles chez: Both materials are available at O&D Impression 3D in FDM, and PA12-GF is also available in SLS (laser sintering) in our SLS material catalogue. The SLS version offers even better mechanical properties thanks to the isotropy of the process: SLS parts have almost identical properties in all directions, which is impossible in FDM.

La Bambu Lab H2C est l'imprimante 3D FDM: The Bambu Lab H2C is the high-end multi-material FDM 3D printer in Bambu Lab's H series, unveiled at Formnext in November 2025. Its big innovation is the Vortek system: instead of purging filament at every colour change, the machine changes nozzle.
Chaque couleur ou matière dispose de sa: Each colour or material has its own nozzle. The H2C handles up to seven nozzles: an automatic rack stores them and the toolhead swaps them in a few seconds, thanks to induction heating that brings a nozzle to temperature in about 8 seconds. The result: far less purge waste and faster multicolour prints.
Le volume d'impression atteint 330 × 320: The build volume reaches 330 × 320 × 325 mm in total (305 × 320 × 325 mm with a single nozzle, 300 × 320 × 325 mm with two nozzles). Nozzles reach 350 °C and the chamber is heated up to 65 °C, so engineering materials such as ABS, ASA, PC, polyamides and PPS can be printed.
La calibration est entièrement automatiq: Calibration is fully automatic: offset between nozzles, build plate check before each print and verification of the installed nozzle. The chamber interior is made of flame-retardant material.
Couplée aux systèmes d'alimentation auto: Combined with the AMS automatic feed systems, the H2C can combine up to 24 colours on a single part, or pair different materials: a rigid and a flexible area, or a soluble support for complex shapes.
Our workshop has five Bambu Lab H2C printers. We use them for multicolour parts, multi-material prototypes and small batches where the colour has to come straight out of the machine, with no painting.

La grande majorité des projets en impres: The vast majority of 3D printing projects do not need high-performance polymers. PLA, PETG or PA12 cover 95% of everyday needs. Le PEEK (PolyEtherEtherKetone) est sans: PEEK (polyether ether ketone) is probably the best-known polymer in the high-performance field. Used since the 1980s in the aerospace, oil and medical industries, it can operate continuously up to 300°C and resist a very wide range of aggressive chemicals. In 3D printing, it requires an extrusion temperature of 380 to 420°C and a chamber heated to 150–200°C, settings that only our INTAMSYS Funmat HT can reach in our workshop.
Le PEKK (PolyEtherKetoneKetone) appartie: PEKK (polyether ketone ketone) belongs to the same family of semi-crystalline aromatic polymers. It offers better interlayer adhesion than PEEK, which results in mechanically more uniform parts. Its service temperature range is slightly lower (up to 250°C), but it is often preferred in aerospace and defence for its better printability and superior dynamic properties.
L'Ultem (PEI : PolyEtherImide) se distin: Ultem (PEI: polyetherimide) differs from the other two in one unique and decisive feature: its native UL94 V0 flame-retardant certification. It is the only one of the three to meet, without additional treatment, the fire-resistance standards imposed by aviation regulation FAR 25.853 (depending on grade). It is widely used to manufacture cabin interior parts, avionics brackets and enclosures for certified industrial electronics.

Le PLA est biosourcé (amidon de maïs) et: PLA is bio-based (corn starch) and biodegradable under industrial composting conditions. In practice, it does not degrade significantly in a home compost or in nature. It is a real but limited environmental advantage.

La reine de la précision et du fini de s: The queen of precision and surface finish. For jewellery, dental applications, figurines and high-end visual prototypes, it has no rival. Main limits: brittleness under impact and a smaller build volume than the other two technologies.

90% of requests are handled in FDM. Versatile, fast, economical, wide choice of materials. Our main recommendation, unless you have specific geometry or finish constraints.
Dès que votre pièce intègre des canaux i: As soon as your part includes internal channels, hinges or a geometry impossible to produce without removing supports, we recommend SLS. The design freedom justifies the extra cost.
Pour la bijouterie, les composants denta: For jewellery, dental components, premium prototypes or any application where a smooth surface and sub-millimetre precision are non-negotiable, resin is the only answer.
Peut-on combiner plusieurs technologies: Can several technologies be combined for one project?
Absolument, et c'est souvent la meilleur: Absolutely, and it is often the best approach. For example: a main structure printed in FDM (large, strong, economical) with resin inserts for fine details, or SLS production parts combined with FDM jigs and fixtures. De manière générale, oui. Cependant, ave: Generally, yes. However, with our calibrated industrial FDM machines, we can achieve ±0.1 mm on critical dimensions, which is enough for most mechanical applications. Resin remains superior for sub-millimetre details such as in jewellery or dental work.

Le SLS nécessite une enceinte chauffée à: SLS requires an enclosure heated to high temperature, complex powder management (recycling, sieving, manual de-powdering) and longer cycle times. Machine and operator costs are much higher than for FDM, but for complex geometries it has no equal.

Oui, nous proposons sur demande des kits: Yes, on request we offer sample kits of our main materials (PLA, PETG, SLS PA12, resin). This lets you make an informed choice before launching production. Contact us to find out more.
FDM, SLS et résine : Trois technologies: FDM, SLS and resin: three complementary, not competing, technologies
Une erreur courante consiste à considére: A common mistake is to see FDM, SLS and resin as three interchangeable options for producing the same part. In reality, these three technologies have distinct and often complementary areas of excellence. Choosing the wrong technology can double the cost, extend lead times or result in a part that does not meet the functional requirements, even with the best material in the world.
Le FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling, égale: FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling, also called FFF) is our core technology. It is the most versatile, the most economical and the one with the widest choice of materials, from bio-based PLA to high-performance industrial PEEK. It is also the only technology that lets us produce very large parts, up to 1 m³, directly in our workshop. For 90% of the requests we receive, FDM is the most effective answer.
Le SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) occup: SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) occupies a very specific but irreplaceable niche: free geometries. As soon as a part has internal channels, hinges printed in one piece, functional gears needing no later assembly, or shapes impossible to mould and hard to print with traditional supports, SLS becomes the technology of choice. The surrounding powder acts as a natural support, no structure is needed and nothing has to be removed. The result is a PA12 part with high mechanical properties and a completely free geometry.
La résine SLA/MSLA est la technologie de: SLA/MSLA resin is the technology of choice for precision and aesthetics. With an XY resolution down to 0.025 mm, it produces smooth surfaces, sub-millimetre details and a visual quality almost identical to injection-moulded parts. For jewellery, dental applications, figurines and high-end visual prototypes, no other technology can match this level of refinement. Its main limit is the build volume, which is much smaller than FDM or SLS.

This lets us recommend the right technology for each specific project without any commercial bias. Technologie SLS : fonctionnement, avanta: SLS technology: how it works, advantages and limits
Une pièce sort d’une imprimante 3D SLS c: A part comes out of an SLS 3D printer as if from a block of powder. Nothing holds it up, no visible scaffolding, just a solid shape hidden in a bed of fine material. That is one of the great strengths of this technology: it can produce complex objects without support structures.
La technologie SLS, pour Selective Laser: SLS technology, for Selective Laser Sintering, is one of the most widely used 3D printing methods for producing strong prototypes, small series and some end-use parts. It is based on a principle that is simple to understand but very precise to master: a laser heats a powder until its particles bond together, layer by layer.
La pièce apparaît peu à peu dans la poud: The part gradually emerges from the powder after manufacturing.
Le principe du SLS repose sur une poudre: SLS is based on a powder and a laser
Le SLS appartient à la famille des procé: SLS belongs to the family of powder bed fusion processes. Unlike a filament 3D printer, which deposits molten material through a nozzle, an SLS machine works with a tank full of powder. This powder becomes the raw material of the part.
Le fonctionnement général suit une logiq: The general operation follows a logic repeated hundreds or thousands of times:
Une fine couche de poudre est étalée sur: A thin layer of powder is spread over a platform.
Un laser trace la forme de la pièce sur: A laser traces the shape of the part on this layer.
Une nouvelle couche de poudre est déposé: A new layer of powder is deposited.
Le cycle recommence jusqu’à former l’obj: The cycle repeats until the complete object is formed.
Le terme « frittage » désigne le fait de: The term "sintering" refers to bonding particles with heat, without always fully liquefying the material as in conventional casting. With the polymers used in SLS, the material can reach a state very close to local melting. The grains soften, fuse together and create a solid zone.
La poudre non atteinte par le laser rest: The powder not reached by the laser stays in place. It surrounds the part during printing and acts as a natural support. This is what makes internal shapes, channels, integrated hinges or lattice structures possible, which would be much harder to produce with other methods.
Les matériaux les plus courants sont des: The most common materials are polymer powders, in particular polyamide, often called nylon. PA12 is very widespread, as it offers a good balance of strength, precision and stability. There are also PA11, powders filled with fibres or glass beads, and flexible materials such as some TPUs. For metals, similar processes such as laser powder bed fusion are often mentioned, but SLS is mainly associated with engineering plastics.
Les étapes du processus SLS vont bien au: The steps of the SLS process go well beyond printing
La réussite d’une pièce SLS ne dépend pa: The success of an SLS part does not depend on the laser alone. It relies on a whole chain of preparation, settings, cooling and finishing. Each step affects the final quality.
Tout commence par un fichier 3D. La pièc: It all starts with a 3D file. The part is designed in CAD software, then exported in a format the machine can read. The file is then prepared by slicing software.
Ce logiciel découpe le modèle en couches: This software cuts the model into very thin layers. It also calculates the path the laser will follow. In an SLS machine, the operator can place several parts in the same build volume. This is often called nesting or filling the build. Because the powder supports the objects, parts can be stacked in the available space, as long as the necessary distances between them are kept.
Cette étape a un effet direct sur le coû: This step has a direct effect on cost and lead time. A well-filled build makes better use of the machine and reduces wasted space.
La poudre doit être propre, sèche et rég: The powder must be clean, dry and uniform. If it contains too much moisture or clumped grains, quality can drop. Parts may then show surface defects, less consistent strength or poorly fused areas.
Avant l’impression, la poudre peut être: Before printing, the powder may be sieved. In many workshops, part of the unsintered powder is recovered after manufacturing and mixed with fresh powder. This mix must remain controlled, as powder that has aged too much can behave differently under heat.
La granulométrie compte aussi. Des grain: Particle size also matters. Fine grains favour detail but must remain easy to spread. A powder that is too irregular gives less uniform layers.
La régularité de la poudre influence la: The consistency of the powder affects the precision of the layers.
La machine chauffe l’ensemble du volume: The machine heats the entire build volume to a temperature close to the point where the powder starts to bond. This preheating is essential. It reduces the energy the laser has to supply and limits thermal stress.
Si la différence de température est trop: If the temperature difference between the areas processed by the laser and the rest of the powder is too great, the parts can warp. Thermal control is therefore one of the most sensitive aspects of SLS.
Le passage du laser et la fusion des par: The laser pass and the fusion of the particles
Une fois la couche de poudre étalée, le: Once the powder layer has been spread, the laser starts moving. It does not sweep the whole surface at random. It follows precisely the contours and solid areas defined in the digital file.
Dans les machines polymères, le laser es: In polymer machines, the laser is often a CO₂ laser. It delivers concentrated energy to the powder. The particles absorb this energy, heat up quickly and fuse with their neighbours. The machine adjusts several parameters:
Ces réglages doivent s’accorder avec le: These settings must match the material. Too little energy causes poor sintering: the part becomes fragile or porous. Too much energy can burn the material, round off details or cause warping.
Quand l’impression est terminée, les piè: When printing is finished, the parts do not come out straight away. The powder block must cool slowly. This phase may seem passive, but it protects the geometry of the parts. Cooling too quickly increases the risk of warping.
Après refroidissement, l’opérateur sort: After cooling, the operator removes the "cake", the volume of powder containing the parts. The objects are freed by hand or with suitable equipment. The loose powder is recovered, then the parts go through depowdering.
Une pièce SLS brute présente souvent une: A raw SLS part often has a slightly grainy surface. Depending on its use, it can be used as is or given a finish:
Microbillage pour améliorer l’aspect de: Bead blasting to improve the surface appearance
Teinture pour obtenir une couleur homogè: Dyeing to obtain a uniform colour
Polissage ou lissage chimique selon le m: Polishing or chemical smoothing depending on the material
Usinage local pour des surfaces fonction: Local machining for precise functional surfaces
Insertion d’éléments filetés ou d’axes m: Inserting threaded elements or metal pins

Les bureaux d’étude utilisent le SLS pou: Design offices use SLS to test shapes, assemblies and mechanisms. An SLS nylon part can be screwed, clipped, handled and fitted into a prototype. It stands up to testing better than a purely visual model.
Par exemple, un fabricant peut imprimer: For example, a manufacturer can print a housing, a handle or a hinge to check ergonomics before launching an injection mould. This reduces back-and-forth and helps detect problems earlier.
Le SLS convient bien aux séries limitées: SLS is well suited to limited runs. When a few dozen or a few hundred parts are needed, creating a mould can cost too much or take too long. Additive manufacturing can then produce the parts directly.
Cette approche sert pour des composants: This approach is used for customised components, technical accessories, spare parts or niche products. It also helps keep production flexible, without storing large volumes.
Dans l’industrie, le SLS produit aussi d: In industry, SLS also produces jigs, inspection fixtures, drilling guides and guards. These objects are not always visible in the final product, but they make work in the workshop easier.
Une pièce SLS légère et solide peut remp: A light, strong SLS part can replace a heavier machined element. It can also incorporate shapes tailored to a specific workstation.
Les outillages imprimés en SLS peuvent ê: Tooling printed in SLS can be light, strong and tailored to a specific use.
Dans le domaine médical, le SLS peut ser: In the medical field, SLS can be used to produce orthoses, anatomical models or components tailored to an individual. These uses require specific materials and validations, but the ability to customise remains a major asset.
Dans le transport, la technologie sert à: In transport, the technology is used to create prototypes of ducts, brackets, housings or lightweight parts. In consumer goods, it is used to test glasses, accessories, cases or parts with shapes that are hard to mould.
Le SLS est aussi intéressant pour les gé: SLS is also useful for internal geometries. Networks of channels, lattices or lightweight structures can reduce mass without removing all the strength.
Les avantages de la technologie SLS sont: The advantages of SLS technology are tangible
La technologie SLS séduit parce qu’elle: SLS technology is attractive because it combines freedom of form with mechanical performance. Its benefits are not theoretical. They show in the way parts are designed and produced.
La poudre soutient la pièce, ce qui évit: The powder supports the part, which avoids most supports and allows complex shapes.
Plusieurs pièces peuvent être placées da: Several parts can be placed in the same volume, which makes small-series production efficient.
Avec des paramètres maîtrisés, la techno: With well-controlled parameters, the technology gives consistent results from one batch to the next.
Les matériaux comme le nylon permettent: Materials such as nylon produce strong components, flexible in some cases and suitable for testing.
Une pièce peut intégrer des clips, charn: A part can incorporate clips, hinges, housings, channels or internal structures from the design stage.
Le post-traitement se concentre surtout: Post-processing focuses mainly on depowdering and finishing.
La liberté de conception est sans doute: Design freedom is probably the best-known advantage. It lets you design a part for its function rather than for the constraints of a mould or a cutting tool. That doesn't mean anything goes without rules. Minimum thicknesses, assembly clearances and powder removal must be planned for.
Le SLS aide aussi à réduire certaines ét: SLS also helps eliminate certain steps. A part that would have required several assembled components can sometimes be printed in one go. This can simplify maintenance and reduce weak points.
Les limites du SLS doivent être prises a: The limits of SLS must be taken seriously
Le SLS n’est pas la réponse idéale à tou: SLS isn't the ideal answer for every project. It offers a lot of possibilities, but it also imposes technical, economic and practical constraints.
La première limite concerne l’aspect de: The first limit concerns surface appearance. A raw SLS part doesn't have the smooth finish of a part injected in a polished mould. Its texture is fine but grainy. For parts that are visible or handled by customers, an additional finish may be needed.
La précision est bonne, mais elle dépend: Precision is good, but it depends on geometry, material and cooling. Large flat parts can warp. Thin areas can be fragile. Very tight tolerances sometimes require machining after printing.
Le temps de cycle est aussi à considérer: Cycle time must also be considered. Printing can be long, and cooling adds further time. For a one-off part, this is usually acceptable. For very large volumes, plastic injection generally remains more suitable once the mould has paid for itself.
La gestion de la poudre demande de la ri: Powder handling requires rigour. It must be stored, sieved and mixed carefully, and operators must be protected from inhaling dust. Professional machines use systems designed for this, but the working environment must remain controlled.
Enfin, le choix des matériaux reste plus: Finally, the choice of materials remains more limited than with other manufacturing processes. Nylon covers many needs, but it doesn't replace all engineering plastics or all metals.
La texture de surface fait partie des po: Surface texture is one of the points to assess before choosing SLS.
Quand choisir le SLS pour un projet de f: When to choose SLS for a manufacturing project
Le SLS est un bon choix quand la pièce d: SLS is a good choice when the part must be functional, complex and produced in low or medium quantities. It is particularly relevant if supports would be a problem with another 3D printing technology.
Il est moins adapté si le besoin princip: It is less suitable if the main requirement is a very smooth surface straight off the machine, a very low cost in very large series, or a specific material not available as SLS powder.
Le bon réflexe consiste à partir de l’us: The right reflex is to start from the end use. Must the part withstand impacts, bending, heat, humidity or repeated friction? Must it be attractive, precise, light, watertight, flexible? The answers guide the choice of material, technology and finishing.
Le SLS montre toute sa valeur quand il e: SLS shows its full value when it is built in from the design stage. A part simply copied from a drawing intended for machining doesn't always benefit from the process. By rethinking shapes, recesses, assemblies and integrated functions, it becomes possible to create a lighter, simpler and sometimes more effective part.
La technologie SLS n’est donc ni une cur: SLS technology is therefore neither a laboratory curiosity nor a magic solution. It is a powerful industrial tool based on a clear idea: turning powder into a solid object with a precise laser.
